answer: The zenith assignment is published and zephyr records each panel. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the mesa graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 846 identities would post 925 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
